title: E0081: Deprecated regex function
plain_english: POSIX regex functions such as `ereg()` and `split()` are deprecated and were removed in PHP 7.0. Use the `preg_*()` family or `explode()` instead.
why_matters: Using removed functions causes fatal errors on PHP 7.0 and later, which breaks the application. The `preg_*()` functions are more capable and actively maintained.
